summary: Young USAFA man drove a GMC Canyon up the Mount Lincoln hiking trail, rear wheel slid off trail in a scree field; driver hiked down to Alma safely; Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery attempted retrieval Aug 30 (8 volunteers, 132 hours, 1,480 miles) but terrain blocked it; tow company Mountain Recovery retrieved the truck Sept 1 with a tracked skid steer; driver cited for driving off designated routes
location: Mount Lincoln hiking trail, near Alma
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery (coordinated with USFS, Park County Sheriff's Office)
notes: Driver uninjured, self-evacuated; vehicle/assist precedent ids 939/3346. Call received Sunday 2023-08-27 (weekday-verified).
